summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Chinese foreign private issuer Baidu, Inc. announcing an upcoming board meeting scheduled for May 18, 2026 to approve the company's unaudited first quarter 2026 financial results. The filing includes standard details about the earnings release timeline, conference call logistics, and pre-registration instructions. It reiterates the company's weighted voting rights structure where Class B shares have 10 votes per share. No special situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change is disclosed. This is a routine earnings announcement with zero special-situation significance.
